correctness.rationale: The Pappus LCF graph is independently identified in mathematical graph references. For k=1..9, every mask is tested via two exact independent-subset recurrences; the verifier builds each full augmented face poset and all covering incidences. Every matching is exhaustively shown acyclic by topological sorting; precisely b_k=(1,10,55,202,481,688,460,64,1) unmatched cells remain, each of dimension 18-2k. Removing the augmented empty/singleton pair yields one critical vertex and b_k higher cells (two vertices for k=9), forcing the claimed integral sphere wedges by Forman. Reduced Euler checks agree at every level. Completeness is finite, and k>9 is excluded by independence number 9.

value.rationale: A complete exact integral homotopy classification of all nine stages for the canonical eighteen-vertex Pappus incidence graph is a natural finite topology census. It reveals five genuinely additional consecutive interior levels with ranks 202,481,688,460,64 and sphere degrees 10,8,6,4,2; the uniform degree-drop and nonshellability for every k>=2 provide structural information not determined by general 3-robust coverage. No universal graph-family statement, integral equivariant classification or downstream theorem is claimed.
